capabilities: Decrypt KeePass .kdbx databases with a WebAssembly Argon2 engine
Render masked inline chips from {{sp:...}} tokens that copy secrets to the clipboard
Render credential tables from safe-passage code blocks
Autocomplete profile, entry, and field references while typing
Insert new secrets into the KeePass database via an Insert Secret modal
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Only the .kdbx database file (plus optional .key/.keyx key file) is needed in the vault; the KeePass application itself is not required since decryption happens in-plugin. Full documentation is hosted at an external link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reference or insert secrets stored in a KeePass database without exposing them in note text.

relations.evidence: a secure, lightweight, and high-performance KeePass integration plugin for Obsidian

summary: KeePass integration that decrypts local .kdbx databases and renders masked credential chips and credential tables inside notes.
